# Valves Valves provide a quick way to stop or allow the flow of gas through a [textlink="pipenet" link="PipeNetworks"].
All valves operate without [textlink="power" link="Power"].
Valves may look simple, but they can be used to build all kinds of complex pipe systems, including: - Signal valves that respond to outputs from air alarms or logic circuits - Pneumatic valves that control the variable release of waste gases from a combustion chamber
